pages.title: ASTRA
pages.message: Mission intent -> parametric geometry -> mesh -> CFD evidence.
pages.subtitle: A reviewable blended-wing-body drone design workflow built around explicit assumptions, deterministic gates and honest result quality.

pages.title: A mission brief becomes a reviewable engineering problem
pages.message: Astra connects requirements, geometry and simulation without hiding the assumptions between them.
pages.challenge: Concept design often fragments the requirement, CAD model and analysis case. Astra keeps those stages linked, versioned and inspectable.
inherited: Case planning, input writing and execution
astra: BWB requirement schema and inverse sizing
VSPAERO screening and deterministic Gmsh farfield
Versioned sessions, gates and result-quality verdict
pages.scope_note: Aerodynamics-first conceptual design. Structures, propulsion, manufacturing and flight validation remain outside the present scope.

pages.title: One traceable loop links intent to evidence
pages.message: Every stage creates an artifact, applies a gate and invalidates downstream evidence when the design changes.
pages.version_note: Upstream revisions preserve history but invalidate downstream results until those stages are rerun.

pages.title: The concept is sized from forces, not styling
pages.message: Steady level flight requires lift to balance weight; the requirement solver closes the planform around that physical constraint.
pages.equation: L = W;  q = 0.5 rho V^2;  S = W / (q CL)
pages.decision: The interface distinguishes the value requested, the value in force and the bound that forced any change. Constraint closure remains visible instead of silently rewriting the brief.

pages.title: Design variables stay connected to their consequences
pages.message: The cockpit exposes geometry, constraints and first-principles explanations while server-side validation remains authoritative.
callouts: Requirement controls show targets, achieved values and active bounds.
The WebGL planform is an instant preview; Apply rebuilds the authoritative OpenVSP model.
Existing candidates can be compared without overwriting the accepted geometry.
Equation estimates remain labelled separately from VSPAERO and CFD evidence.

pages.title: Deterministic mesh gates protect the solver handoff
pages.message: The validated OpenVSP surface is retained as the boundary while the farfield volume and patch types are generated and checked deterministically.
method: Use the watertight STL triangles directly as the aircraft boundary.
Generate the farfield with deterministic Delaunay tetrahedralization.
Classify aircraft walls and the symmetry plane before case writing.
Stop on zero cells, conversion failure or a failed mesh-quality gate.
pages.measured_change: Netgen optimization reduced average non-orthogonality from 22.6 to 17.9 and maximum skewness from 2.6 to 1.5 [C].

pages.title: Flow fields make the result physically inspectable
pages.message: Pressure and velocity images are presented as evidence from the named verification case, not as generic simulation decoration.
pages.pressure_note: The surface field shows the pressure distribution over the BWB, including the leading-edge suction region [C].
pages.velocity_note: The symmetry-plane slice shows stagnation, acceleration over the body and the downstream wake [C].

pages.title: A clean solver exit is not the engineering verdict
pages.message: Astra combines convergence, force history, plausibility and the mission target before accepting a result.
observations: The completed verification case reached residual levels in the 1e-5 to 1e-6 range [C].
The coarse CFD lift coefficient was 0.065 against a required 0.181 [C].
Near-wall resolution was approximately y+ 900 [C], so the lift result was treated as under-resolved.
The workflow routed the case to revise-design instead of reporting a false success [C].
pages.proves: The case ran, the monitored solution settled, the fields can be inspected and the quality gate identified a mission-level disagreement.
pages.does_not_prove: The coarse result is not a validated final aerodynamic performance prediction and does not close mesh independence.

pages.title: The project demonstrates judgement as well as automation
pages.message: The strongest outcome is a workflow that exposes uncertainty, records decisions and refuses unsupported certainty.
lessons: A successful process exit does not establish valid physics.
Probabilistic steps need deterministic validators and fallbacks.
Mesh quality can dominate solver behaviour and result credibility.
pages.next_experiment: Next experiment [D]: run controlled coarse, medium and fine mesh tiers, then compare force stability, lift and near-wall resolution. The hypothesis is falsified if refinement does not narrow the model disagreement or improve the near-wall evidence.

pages.title: Astra is a transparent extension, not a black-box claim
pages.message: The portfolio separates inherited infrastructure, authored engineering work, measured evidence and unresolved limitations.
limits: No structural, propulsion or manufacturing validation
VLM does not model stall; stall limits are analytic
The displayed CFD result remains a coarse verification case
pages.attribution: Astra extends the open-source Foam-Agent CFD foundation. The inherited graph remains the CFD spine; the BWB design loop, cockpit, design-session lifecycle and physical-quality gates are the Astra extension.
